subject: loose-knot glass creature

composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Invent a small character from a loose knot of smoked glass, with two short feet and a tiny face on the upper bend. Keep the knot opening broad enough to see through, while one warm-gold inclusion sits deep inside the lower loop. Use controlled studio light on a pale gray field, revealing curved thickness and soft internal reflections. Avoid sharp edges, complex jewelry forms, or mysterious symbols. Square 1024x1024, with a clear central silhouette and no circular border. Original peaceful design, no lettering, logos, or watermark.
